description: History accumulates, a summary checkpoint is taken, the writer is restarted by SIGINT, and a later prompt continues. interrupt is signal-driven but resolves through a normal shutdown now that ACP's frame read is released when its Serve context is cancelled; before that fix an idle agent ignored SIGINT entirely and this Scenario was deliberately absent from the suite. Passing requires the same checkpoint-chain continuity the other restart Scenarios demand, after an owned process group was genuinely terminated and reaped -- reap is proven before relaunch, never assumed from the signal having been sent.
